columns.name: AppId
columns.description: Unique identifier for the Brightspace app.

columns.name: GlobalId
columns.description: The globally unique identifier. Field can be null.

columns.name: IsLocal
columns.description: Indicates whether the app was created locally rather than installed.

columns.name: State
columns.description: Indicates whether the app is enabled or disabled.

columns.name: InstalledVersion
columns.description: Currently installed version of the app. Field can be null.

columns.name: CreatedDate
columns.description: Timestamp when the app record was created (UTC).

columns.name: CreatedBy
columns.description: Identifier for the user who created the app record.

columns.name: LastPublishedDate
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent publish operation for this app (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: LastPublishedBy
columns.description: Identifier for the user who last published the app. Field can be null.

columns.name: LastUpdatedDate
columns.description: Timestamp of the most recent update operation for this app (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: LastUpdatedBy
columns.description: Identifier for the user who last updated the app. Field can be null.

columns.name: Categories
columns.description: Comma-separated list of product categories used to organize app listings. Field can be null.

columns.name: OrgId
columns.description: Identifier for the org unit that owns the app.

columns.name: DefaultDeploymentId
columns.description: Identifier of the default deployment mapped to this app. Field can be null.

columns.name: DateDeleted
columns.description: Date and time when the app was deleted (UTC). Field can be null.

columns.name: LastModified
columns.description: Date when the app was last modified (UTC).
